name: get_user_profile
description: Get the authenticated user's profile, subscription tier, and company research count.

name: get_billing_status
description: Check the user's 7-day PRO trial remaining days, active billing plan, and workspace status.

name: list_missions
description: List all research and outreach missions for the current user.

name: create_mission
description: Create a new cold outreach mission. Follow the 4 Deliverability Rules for the offer: 1) Zero links in cold emails, 2) Set role and peer-to-peer tone, 3) Focus on value without price lists or promo hype, 4) Low-friction ask for Primary Inbox delivery.

missionName.description: Descriptive mission name, e.g. 'German Solar Installers'

targetProfile.description: Target profile or offer description following the 4 Deliverability Rules (no links, value-focused, no price lists)

offerBody.description: Direct offer text / core value proposition (no links, focused on solved pain points)

offerSignature.description: Plain text signature (e.g. 'Best regards, Alex | Head of Growth at Acme, +1 555-0199')

dailyLimit.description: Max emails to send per day (default 10)

timezone.description: Timezone for delivery window, e.g. 'Europe/Berlin' or 'America/New_York'

name: update_mission_offer
description: Update the offer, value proposition, or sender signature for an existing mission in AirPulsar.

offerBody.description: New offer text / value proposition following the 4 Deliverability Rules (no links, value-focused, no price lists)

name: add_company_lead
description: Add a custom company lead directly into a mission with research, key personnel, and 3-step email sequences without running live web search.

missionId.description: Mission ID to add the lead into

location.description: Company headquarters location for timezone-aware scheduling (e.g. 'Munich, Germany', 'Austin, TX, US', 'London, UK')

facts.description: Key facts, pain points, or research highlights

emailDrafts.description: Personalized cold emails for this company

scheduleTime.description: When Step 1 should be sent: 'auto' (dynamically spaced in recipient timezone), 'now', 'tomorrow', '+2d', '+1w', or ISO string

name: update_delivery_settings
description: Configure pacing, working hours, and daily dispatch quotas for a mission or workspace.

missionId.description: Mission ID to update, or omit for workspace defaults

dailyQuota.description: Maximum emails to dispatch per day (e.g. 25)

minIntervalMinutes.description: Minimum interval between consecutive emails in minutes (e.g. 8)

maxIntervalMinutes.description: Maximum interval between consecutive emails in minutes (e.g. 24)

workHoursStart.description: Start of sending window in HH:mm (e.g. '09:00')

workHoursEnd.description: End of sending window in HH:mm (e.g. '17:00')

name: get_leads
description: Query leads for a mission with filtering by outreach stage, score, and verification status. Supports searching by email or company name.

searchQuery.description: Search query to match company name, website domain, or prospect email address

name: get_company_dossier
description: Get complete deep research dossier for a company, including personnel, technology, facts, and drafts.

name: update_company_contacts
description: Add, update, or reorder key personnel contacts for a prospect company.

name: enrich_company_data
description: Append custom factual intelligence notes or confirmed operational facts to a company dossier.

facts.description: Array of factual intelligence statements to append

name: get_scheduled_outreach
description: List queued emails and upcoming dispatches ordered chronologically.

name: manage_contact_queue
description: Approve, pause, or reject outreach for a prospect company. Critical: When a prospect replies to an outreach email or asks to unsubscribe, call this tool with action='PAUSE' (or 'REJECT') to immediately freeze automated follow-up steps (Step 2, Step 3).

action.description: Action to take on lead: 'PAUSE' halts scheduled follow-ups, 'REJECT' marks lead as unsubscribed/unsuitable

reason.description: Reason for pause (e.g. 'Prospect replied: Interested in demo') or rejection note

name: reschedule_outreach
description: Reschedule the next automated email dispatch date for a lead.

nextActionAt.description: ISO datetime string or relative string like '+2d', '+4h', 'tomorrow', 'next_week'

name: set_lead_reminder
description: Set, update, or clear a task reminder with a target follow-up date and context note for a company. When a prospect replies asking to follow up later ('contact me in 2 weeks', 'out of office until Nov 10', 'busy right now'), use this tool to schedule a reminder so it automatically appears in the user's Reminders tab in AirPulsar.

reminderDate.description: Reminder date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format, relative string like '+2w', '+1m', 'tomorrow', 'next_week', or null to mark completed/cleared

reminderNote.description: Context note explaining what to follow up on (e.g. 'Requested follow-up after ERP implementation in mid-November')

name: update_email_drafts
description: Edit custom subjects and body content for the 3-step outreach sequence of a company.

name: set_campaign_status
description: Start, pause, or resume automated email outreach dispatching via Gmail for a mission. NOTE: This ONLY controls outgoing emails and does NOT run company discovery/search.

status.description: Target outreach status: 'PAUSED' halts email sending; 'ACTIVE' resumes sending emails. Never call to search companies.

name: manage_blacklist
description: View, append, remove, or scrub excluded company domains and email addresses from the user's outreach blacklist.

action.description: Action: 'GET' to inspect blacklist, 'ADD' to append domains/emails, 'REMOVE' to delete entries, 'CLEAN_LEADS' to scrub and reject blacklisted leads from a mission

items.description: Array of domains (e.g. 'competitor.com') or email addresses to add or remove

missionId.description: Target mission ID when action is 'CLEAN_LEADS' (or omit to clean all user leads)

name: manage_campaign_templates
description: List, create, or apply reusable cold email campaign sequence templates in AirPulsar.

action.description: Action: 'LIST' to view saved templates, 'SAVE' to create/update a template, 'APPLY' to set a template on a mission, 'DELETE' to remove

name: export_leads_csv
description: Export verified leads, decision-makers, and email sequences of a mission as RFC 4180 CSV.

name: get_email_status
description: View connected email channels: global workspace Gmail and dedicated per-mission email accounts.

missionId.description: Check specific mission email override status

name: disconnect_email
description: Disconnect/unlink an email account from a specific mission or globally from the workspace.

missionId.description: Mission ID to disconnect dedicated email from. If omitted, disconnects global workspace email.

name: connect_mission_email
description: Connect a specific Gmail account to a mission or globally. If a previous email was bound to the mission, it is automatically unlinked/logged out first.

missionId.description: Mission ID to bind the email to. If omitted, connects as global workspace email.

targetEmail.description: Email address user wants to connect (e.g. 'sales@company.com'). Prefills Google sign-in.

name: set_sender_alias
description: Configure or switch the active custom domain sender email address (Send-As alias, e.g. 'henadz@airpulsar.com') for outreach. Can be set globally for the workspace or specifically for a mission.

alias.description: Custom domain sender email configured in Gmail Send-As (e.g. 'henadz@airpulsar.com') or empty string to reset to primary Gmail address

missionId.description: Mission ID to bind this sender alias to. If omitted, applies to the global workspace.

name: get_domain_email_guide
description: Get the complete architectural guide and copy-paste SMTP parameters for setting up free custom domain emails in Gmail (Cloudflare Catch-All + Resend SMTP + Send-As) without paid Google Workspace.
